name: Difference Engine
desc: A brass calculating-engine plate mid-computation — columns of decimal figure-wheels roll like odometer drums, each place turning ten times slower than the one below so carries creep and flick up the stack, a hand-crank drives the whole register, and dash-dot carry linkages and a live figure readout tick over every frame.

energy.doc: crank speed + digit-roll rate + glow + line weight + plate drift

scale.doc: register footprint — 2.2 fills the frame with figure-wheels

hue.doc: plate tint (brass/schematic); other styles are fixed inks

anno.doc: annotation: column heads, callouts, title block, rpm readout

style.doc: aesthetic: aged brass engine / prussian cyanotype / engraved plate / bookkeeping ledger / abstracted ring-and-numeral schematic

alpha.doc: ink opacity over the plate ground
